initialExam.title: TSPSC Group 4 Services 2026
initialExam.description: Group 4 Services exam for Junior Assistant, Typist, Steno, and other clerical posts in Telangana state government departments. Entry-level opportunity for 10th/12th pass candidates.
initialExam.eligibility: SSC (10th Pass) or Intermediate (12th Pass) depending on post
initialExam.qualifications: 10th or 12th Pass from a recognized board
initialExam.syllabus: General Studies & Mental Ability (150Q): Indian History, Geography, Polity, Economy, Science, Current Affairs, Mental Ability & Reasoning. Secretarial Abilities (100Q): Office Management, Typing, Computer Basics (for relevant posts).
initialExam.examPattern: Single paper: 150 questions, 150 marks, 2.5 hours (OMR based). No negative marking.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Exam → Certificate Verification → Final Merit List
initialExam.jobRole: Junior Assistant, Typist, Junior Steno, Bill Collector, Junior Accountant in state government offices
initialExam.careerGrowth: Junior Assistant → Senior Assistant → Superintendent → Section Officer through promotions and departmental exams.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit tspsc.gov.in 2. Register with One Time Registration 3. Fill application 4. Upload documents 5. Pay fee 6. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, CCA, Medical Benefits, Pension, Leave Encashment, LTC

ageLimitDetails.relaxation: BC: 5 years, SC/ST: 10 years, PwD: 10 years
